nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: The proof for the error workflow (Layer 1). n8n does not fire error workflows for manual test runs, so the probe is a production webhook that throws on purpose. It is committed INACTIVE and unpublished: publish it for the proof, POST to /webhook/error-probe, expect HTTP 500 here and the run-error email + WhatsApp, then unpublish. While unpublished nobody can reach it.

parameters.jsCode:
// Deliberate. This is the one node in the platform that exists to fail.
throw new Error('error probe: deliberate throw to prove ryvo_error_handler reports it (' + new Date().toISOString() + ')');
